'''Terry Zajic''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 4th at [[October 2001 Lompoc tournament]] on 13 October 2001, according to Dunya Ertan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3053">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-14-home-of-the-surf-time-usa-lompoc-10-1301d3053/ home-of-the-surf-time-usa-lompoc-10-1301], DeckTech (Dunya "Hardpack" Ertan, 14 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-14-home-of-the-surf-time-usa-lompoc-10-1301d3053/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
